item.title: Latch 2.0
item.description:
Latch 2.0

  • Gated General and Recognition Settings behind Touch ID session lock.
  • Robust Keychain resilience for Ad-Hoc and Development distribution.
  • Universal DMG packaging with zero 7-day expiration timers.
  • Hardened Runtime library validation compatibility with Sparkle updater.
  • Enhanced non-destructive session reset safeguarding enrolled face identities.

item.title: Latch 1.0
item.description:
Latch 1.0

  • Initial release of Latch: Biometric Face & Touch ID App Lock for macOS.
  • Instant, on-device facial recognition using Apple Vision and ArcFace Core ML.
  • Endpoint Security fail-closed system extension application interception.
  • Interactive Dynamic Notch UI with micro-animations and trackpad haptics.
  • Hardware-backed AES-256-GCM encryption in macOS Keychain.
  • Native Sparkle 2 automatic updates via GitHub Releases.
